# VFM NOVA

> VFM NOVA, at ainova.to, sets up websites, AI assistants and everyday business tools for small business owners who would rather run their business than learn tech. Prices are starting points, and the written quote is the final price.

## Services
- [What we build](https://ainova.to/services.html): Websites, AI assistants, booking, customer lists and follow-ups, explained in plain English.
- [Packages and pricing](https://ainova.to/packages.html): Launch from $997, Growth from $2,495, Systems from $4,995, plus add-ons and a price calculator.
- [Templates](https://ainova.to/templates.html): Sample website designs by style.
- [VFM Engine](https://ainova.to/engine.html): A monthly growth plan for $400 a month. Results aren't guaranteed.
- [Partner Directory](https://ainova.to/partners.html): Businesses listed through VFM Engine. Paid listings are labeled.
